master.description: Senior architect, planner, reviewer, and decision-maker for the PolicyGraph monorepo. Delegates reconnaissance to Explorer and bounded implementation to Implementer.

explorer.description: Read-only PolicyGraph reconnaissance agent. Finds exact files, symbols, behavior, tests, dependencies, and likely change locations; does not implement or redesign.

implementer.description: Fast PolicyGraph execution agent. Implements precise bounded tasks from Master in client or server, preserves conventions, runs requested validation, and reports blockers without redesigning scope.
